apis.start_conditional: Original initial supplied-context/action validation and initialization exactly once, returning explicit model state or original unknown.
apis.advance_to_collection_or_terminal: Consumes next-event state; returns a fresh post-collect continuation or terminal original result.
apis.fork_conditional: One deepcopy of engine+all frames and collected values, preserving cycles/aliases; source instance remains unused.
apis.resume_same_action: Consumes only the post-collect frame; completes decision/activate/tick/after-event in order with unchanged action.

claims_not_made: Counterfactual suffix change or online search
boundaries: Only next_event and after_collect_before_record_and_action are accepted public program counters.
Consumed state and changed action reject. Original caught exception kinds return original conditional unknown; other exceptions propagate.
A resumed count20001 early return bypasses finish; an event beyondH40 is popped and time assigned before break without count/hook.
All physical handlers, collected guards and lazy activation statements retain full defining globals.
Real original-outcome fields never fill missing stack or model state.
